What is a disadvantage of nuclear fission as a source of energy?
A
Nuclear power stations are expensive to build.
B
Nuclear power stations are unreliable.
C
Nuclear power stations can only provide small quantities of energy.
D
Nuclear power stations release large quantities of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.

options.label: A
options.text: Nuclear power stations are expensive to build.

options.label: C
options.text: Nuclear power stations can only provide small quantities of energy.

options.label: D
options.text: Nuclear power stations release large quantities of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
